rows.title: The germinal set is mounted with its own journey, its draft and reference, and its own specs
rows.detail: Germinal products becomes a sibling set of live animals in the animals frontend, mounted at /germinal-products with its own journey, flow, obligations, cookies, gateway and set services. Its journey pages sit at /germinal-products/notifications/{journeyId}/{slug} using the live-animals slugs, each a copy of its live-animals feature folder plus the germinal differences, and its overview, check answers, declaration and confirmation pages are its own copies too. Every live-animal field that is not marked as applying to the animal journey only is carried over; the CPH number and the permanent address, which are, are not, so the set has no CPH number page and no permanent address page. This row lays the set down and proves it with its first page: starting a germinal notification creates a draft with the same kind of reference a live-animals notification gets and lands on the set's own copy of the origin page. The set's end-to-end, accessibility and security specs live in the existing animals Playwright project. The plants frontend gets no germinal set, so no germinal-only difference changes plants.
acceptanceCriteria: Starting a germinal products notification through the germinal set's own start creates a notification with status Draft and a reference of the form GBN-AG-<two-digit year>-<six characters>, shown in the status strip from the first page, and lands on the set's 'Origin of the import' page under /germinal-products/notifications/<journeyId>/ using the live-animals slug. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-027, -p1-048; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-055)
Every germinal products notification's reference begins GBN-AG. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-028)

The germinal origin page asks the same questions, with the same heading, hints, options and error messages, as the finished live-animals origin page, and saves its answers to the germinal notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011, -p1-013, -p1-015)

The germinal set has no CPH number page and no permanent address page: opening either live-animals slug under a germinal notification shows the page not found page. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-076, -p5-077, -p5-078; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-015, -p3-022)

The germinal set's end-to-end, accessibility and security specs sit in the existing animals Playwright project, under tests/animals/e2e/germinal-products, tests/animals/a11y/germinal-products and tests/animals/security/germinal-products, with no new Playwright project. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-061, -p1-062, -p1-063)

The accessibility specs walk the germinal pages built so far and hold each to WCAG 2.2 AA on first load and with answers filled, under the suite's existing axe rules, and the security scan drives the germinal routes. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-062, -p1-063)
The high-risk plants frontend has no germinal set and no germinal page: its journey and its pages are unchanged by this row. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-056)
rows.gate: Look at the germinal set's skeleton (its mount, chrome, the category on the stored record, the cross-set guard and its copied origin page) before the other germinal page copies follow it: every later germinal row copies a live-animals feature folder into this set the same way.

rows.title: The germinal commodity page carries its own search hint and offers germinal commodities only, and the live animals search offers none
rows.detail: The germinal set's copy of 'What are you importing?' keeps the live-animals page as it stands and changes only its search hint, which tells the trader they can search for semen, ova or embryos. Each set holds one category, so the germinal search offers germinal-product commodities alone and the live-animals search offers live-animal commodities alone: a consignment mixing the two is never written. While the catalogue is the one today's commodity data holds, the germinal page offers the germinal lines in it, with embryos and ova as one combined line, found through the page's own Search button. The eighteen-item catalogue with embryos and ova apart waits in its own blocked row.
acceptanceCriteria: The germinal 'What are you importing?' page keeps the live-animals title, caption, heading, ITAHC inset, label, buttons, Cancel link and Back link to the origin page, and its search hint reads 'You can search for semen, ova or embryos, or by common name (for example, cattle), Latin name (Bos taurus) or commodity code (05119985).' (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-097; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-057, -p3-058, -p3-078; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-017)

The germinal page's search offers germinal-product commodities only: searching 'cattle' on a germinal notification lists cattle germinal commodities and no live-animal commodity. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, -p1-025, -p1-026, -p1-110; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-098)

The germinal page offers the germinal commodities today's commodity data holds under 05111000 and 05119985, with their existing names and codes and with embryos and ova as one combined 'Embryos/Ova' line, each result showing its species and germinal product type. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-025, -p1-026; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-010, -p2-016, -p2-019)

Searching on the germinal page happens through the page's Search button, with or without JavaScript: typing alone shows no results, and typing 'semen' then pressing Search lists only semen commodities. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-059, -p2-010, -p2-016)

Ticking a germinal commodity's species and saving takes the germinal notification on as the live-animals page does, and reopening the page shows the selection. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-059, -p3-064)

On a live-animals notification the commodity search offers live-animal commodities only: searching 'semen' or 05119985 lists no results, while cattle 0102, horses 0101 and cats under 01061900 are still found, chosen and saved. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-025, -p1-026; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-018, -p2-019, -p2-025; repo:tests repo-tests-p1-042)
openQuestions: A germinal-only commodity search needs new code in trade-imports-reference-data, and the split-off reference-lists theme owns all of referencedata:src, so no remaining theme may touch it. Default: build this row's frontend half against a stubbed germinal search, and either add the germinal search endpoint as a small change outside this backlog or widen the reference-lists pointer at a re-distil.

rows.title: The germinal opening run and its main import reason: two reasons and four purposes
rows.detail: A germinal products notification is started by the germinal set's own start, reached from the type question's Germinal products option or from 'Create new' on the set's own notification list at /germinal-products. It creates the draft without asking the notification type question, opens at the set's origin page and runs on through 'What are you importing?' to 'Main import reason' in the order live animals uses. The germinal copy of the main import reason page offers only Internal market and Transit, and Internal market reveals only four purposes, each keeping its live-animal wording. A reason or purpose outside those lists is never saved.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Create new' on the germinal set's own notification list at /germinal-products creates a germinal products draft without asking the notification type question and lands on the germinal origin page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-103, -p3-104, -p3-108, -p3-109; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-012, -p1-102; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-053, -p3-054; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-095)

Saving the germinal origin page goes to the germinal 'What are you importing?' page, and saving a germinal selection there goes to the germinal 'Main import reason' page, in the order live animals uses. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-064, -p5-029; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-099)

rows.title: Germinal Commodity details asks total gross weight, number of packages and temperature, and the record stores and publishes them with interim type codes
rows.detail: The germinal set's copy of Commodity details asks, for each chosen species, an optional 'Total gross weight' in kilograms followed by a 'Number of packages', and always asks one optional 'Temperature' for the consignment after all the commodity blocks. A germinal commodity has one Selected commodities row listing all its chosen species, and its block is headed by the commodity's name and code. The animals backend holds the gross weight as a decimal on each species line and the temperature on every line of the notification, and shows both back; neither is published, because the profile the service publishes against carries no field for them. The number of packages is the line's quantity when the notification is published. While the catalogue still holds combined embryos-and-ova lines, each germinal trade line carries an interim type code: SEMEN for a semen line and EMBRYO for a combined line, so a combined line submitted in that time records ova as embryos.
acceptanceCriteria: Each germinal species block asks 'Total gross weight' in a narrow text input with the suffix 'kg', before 'Number of packages'; left blank it shows no error and saves. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-030; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-031; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-032; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-004, -p5-005, -p5-012; c-022, c-231, c-232)

Each germinal species block asks 'Number of packages', with no hint and no '(when required)', after 'Total gross weight', and a germinal species block asks for no number of animals. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-029, -p3-034; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-032, -p5-034; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-033; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-013, -p5-015, -p5-016; c-234)

After all the commodity blocks the germinal Commodity details page always asks one 'Temperature' radio question, its legend at label size rather than a heading, with the hint 'How will the products be stored' and the options Ambient, Chilled and Frozen in that order; left unanswered it shows no error and saves. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-039, -p3-040; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-033; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-034; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-023 to -p5-031; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021; c-228, c-232, c-233)

A germinal commodity has one Selected commodities row listing all its chosen species, such as '05111000 | Cattle, Semen | Bos taurus', its block is headed '<name> (<code>)' such as 'Cattle, Semen (05111000)', and its species sections are separated by section breaks. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-030; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-031)

A total gross weight such as 24.50, a number of packages and a temperature saved on germinal Commodity details are shown again when the page is reopened; the weight is held as that species line's gross weight in kilograms, as a decimal, and the temperature on every commodity line of the notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, -p1-022, -p1-040, -p1-042; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-004, -p5-024; c-022, c-231, c-233)

In the notification published for a germinal products notification each trade line's quantity is its number of packages, and the payload carries no gross weight and no temperature. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-040 to -p1-043; c-022, c-234)

In that published payload each germinal trade line carries the type code SEMEN for a semen line and EMBRYO for a combined 'Embryos/Ova' line, taken from the line's stored germinal product type. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-036; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-026 to -p2-028; c-273, c-282)
openQuestions: The interim EMBRYO code for a combined 'Embryos/Ova' line rests on nobody objecting rather than an active approval (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-029). Default: build EMBRYO, so a combined line submitted before the catalogue separates them records ova as embryos.

rows.title: Germinal Commodity details checks weight and packages, listing errors by question
rows.detail: The germinal set's Commodity details page checks the figures it asks for: the total gross weight must be a number greater than 0, at most 1,000 kilograms and to no more than two decimal places, and the number of packages is required and must be a whole number from 1 to 1,000. Where the design gives a message it is used; the rest follow the GOV.UK pattern for a maximum. With errors on several species, every total gross weight error comes before every number of packages error, and the optional temperature never appears in the summary.
acceptanceCriteria: A Total gross weight that is not a number greater than 0 (digits with an optional decimal part, no sign, commas or units), such as 0, shows 'Enter a number greater than 0', linked from the error summary to that species' field and shown inline. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-033; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-039; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-036; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-005)

A Total gross weight over 1,000, such as 1000.01, shows 'Total gross weight must be 1,000kg or less', linked to that species' field and shown inline; 1,000 itself saves. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-005, -p5-011)

A Total gross weight of 1.5 or 24.50 saves; one with more than two decimal places, such as 1.555, shows 'Total gross weight must have 2 decimal places or fewer', linked to that species' field and shown inline. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-005, -p5-009, -p5-011; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-041; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-036; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-022)

(prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-035, -p3-035-m1; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-036; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-017)

A Number of packages that is not a whole number of 1 or more, such as 'x' or 0, shows 'Enter a whole number greater than 0', in the error summary and inline. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-036; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-040; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-037; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-020, -p5-022)

rows.title: Germinal identification asks once per species for donor, dates and identification number
rows.detail: Germinal products are identified once per species, whatever the number of packages. The germinal set's copy of Identification details shows each chosen species one editable form, headed by the species name with no count, prefilled with what was saved, with no panel button and no table of saved entries. The form asks for a donor name or identification, a collection date, a production date and an identification number or mark, in that order, for every germinal commodity the set offers. The panel keeps the species heading and the link back to Commodity details, and the page's Selected commodities summary counts packages rather than animals. Valid germinal Commodity details lead here.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid germinal Commodity details continue to the germinal Identification details page. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-041, -p5-042; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-038)

Each germinal species panel keeps its species heading and a 'Change number of animals' link to Commodity details, worded as for live animals. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-074; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-071)

Each germinal species shows one editable form headed 'Enter details for <species>' with no count, such as 'Enter details for Bos taurus', whatever its number of packages, with no panel button and no table of saved entries. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-044, -p5-047; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-069, -p5-083; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-054; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-034, -p5-062)

The form asks 'Donor name/ID' (text), 'Collection date', 'Production date' and 'Identification number/mark' (text), in that order, for every germinal commodity the set offers. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-018, -p5-019; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-072 to -p5-075, -p5-080-m1; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-054; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-032, -p5-035, -p5-038, -p5-039, -p5-041, -p5-042; c-230)

The values typed into each germinal species' form are saved by the page's 'Save and continue' and by 'Save and return to overview', and are shown prefilled when the page is opened again. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-047; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-083; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-046, -p1-047)

On the germinal identification page the 'Selected commodities' quantity column is headed 'Number of packages' and shows each species' saved count, while the live-animals page keeps 'Number of animals'. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-070; c-234)

rows.title: Germinal identification dates and donor: single text inputs with the date and length checks
rows.detail: On the germinal identification page the collection and production dates are each a single text input with an example hint, working without JavaScript. The donor name or identification and the identification number or mark are each capped at 58 characters, each date must be given as a day, month and four-digit year and must be a real date, and nothing else is checked: any real date, past or future, is accepted, a one- or two-digit day and month are accepted, and the production date is never compared with the collection date. Errors are listed in field order, each linked to its own field.
acceptanceCriteria: On the germinal identification page 'Collection date' and 'Production date' are each a single text input with the hint 'For example, 27/03/2026', and both can be typed in and saved with JavaScript turned off, reading back as typed. rows.title: The germinal set has no Additional details step, and a germinal species counts as identified once it has one identifier
rows.detail: The germinal set leaves the Additional details page out: its overview section for the consignment holds Commodity details, and Identification details where it applies, only, and a valid identification page reached through the journey leads straight on to Arrival details. Every germinal identification field is optional on its own, so a partly or wholly blank entry saves without a missing-value error, but a selected germinal species counts as identified only once its entry holds at least one of the four identifiers, and that one bar decides both the overview's Complete status and whether the notification can be submitted. The identification page itself shows no message for the rule.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal notification's overview has no Additional details task: its consignment section holds 'Commodity details', and 'Identification details' where it applies, only. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-138-m1; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-063; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016, -p1-057)

'Save and continue' on a valid germinal identification page reached through the journey goes straight to Arrival details; opened from its overview task, the review or the template review, it returns there instead. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-085; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-063; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-196)

Saving a germinal species' form partly or wholly blank shows no missing-value error and never holds back 'Save and continue'. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-060; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-082; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-002, -p5-003, -p5-036, -p5-046, -p5-056, -p5-064, -p5-074)

The overview's Identification details task shows Complete only once every selected germinal species, a lone species included, has at least one of the four identifiers saved, and the identification page shows no message for the rule. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-061; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-086; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-188, -p1-189; c-235, c-277)

Submitting a germinal notification with a selected species whose entry holds no identifier, a lone species included, is refused, and it submits once that species has one identifier. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-002, -p5-003; document:dr1-parity-notes document-dr1-parity-notes-p1-085; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-188, -p1-189; c-235, c-277)
rows.notes: existingRow inc-183, whose id, theme and dependencies (inc-052, inc-099, inc-105, inc-182, inc-186) the combiner keeps. Combines the missing Additional details step (req-181) with the one-identifier bar (req-261): both are the set's flow and obligation rules around identification, observable only once its overview, review, template mode, Arrival details and declaration copies exist, so it stays apart from the identification page rows, which build early. c-277 and c-235 (ruled): a lone germinal species is not exempt, and the prototype's lone-species exemption and empty-entry rule are not copied into this set. The template review the page returns to is the set's own copy (inc-186), not the live-animals template-review folder the split-off type-question-and-templates theme owns, so nothing here falls in that theme's code.

rows.title: Both save buttons make the same checks on every germinal page that shows them
rows.detail: On every page of the germinal set that offers both 'Save and continue' and 'Save and return to overview', the two buttons make exactly the same checks, and differ only in where they go once every answer passes. The pages copied from live animals bring the behaviour with them; the set's own Commodity details and Identification details pages, whose weight, package, length and date rules are written for this set, are built with it, so no page is an exception and a trader who saves and returns never leaves a page holding answers the service has not checked.
acceptanceCriteria: On every germinal page that shows both buttons, pressing 'Save and return to overview' with a missing or invalid answer keeps the trader on the page, shows an error in the summary and inline for each one, keeps what they entered, and saves nothing. (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-008, -p1-009, -p1-013, -p1-024; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; c-339)

On germinal Commodity details, pressing 'Save and return to overview' with a blank number of packages, a total gross weight of 0 and a total gross weight over 1,000 shows the same errors, in the same order, as pressing 'Save and continue' does. (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-010, -p1-011, -p1-013; c-339)

On germinal Identification details, pressing 'Save and return to overview' with a donor name over 58 characters and a collection date that is not a real date shows the same errors, in the same order, as pressing 'Save and continue' does. (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-010, -p1-011, -p1-013; c-339)

On every germinal page that shows both buttons, with nothing missing or invalid 'Save and return to overview' saves the answers and shows the notification overview, while 'Save and continue' saves them and goes to the next page of the journey. (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-008, -p1-009; c-339)
rows.notes: New row: req-2162 was adopted after this area's last reconcile, when c-339 settled that the same-checks rule reaches the germinal set, so no existing row covers it (existingRow null). One slice, not merged into the germinal Commodity details or Identification details rows: it is a rule over the whole set, and it is only observable once the set's own pages and the rest of its journey exist, so it comes after them (inc-053, inc-177, inc-182). The pages copied from live animals inherit the behaviour from the live-animals and shared journey work the split-off journey-foundation theme builds (req-1625), so this row proves the copies and builds the rule into the two germinal-only pages. The same settlement is recorded page by page in c-321, c-323 and c-362, and how far the checks reach on any one page is c-372, so the plan should read those with this row. Sibling requirements from the same ruling cover amending (req-2188) and template pages (req-2202) in other areas; keep this row to the journey pages so those are not duplicated.

rows.title: Once commodities come from the central reference data, the germinal catalogue holds eighteen items, with embryos and ova apart and each with its own type code
rows.detail: The germinal data applies to twelve named commodities, and the published payload has separate codes for embryos and ova, so embryos and ova become separate catalogue items: eighteen in all. When the commodity list comes from the central reference data and the germinal catalogue is drawn from it, the germinal catalogue holds those eighteen items, each offering its own species, selections show as live-animal selections do, and each germinal trade line carries the code for its own product type.
acceptanceCriteria: The germinal catalogue holds 18 items, sorted by name, with their codes shown with the leading zero: Cattle, Goat, Horse, Pig and Sheep each as '<Animal>, Embryos' and '<Animal>, Ova' (05119985); 'Cattle, Semen' (05111000); and 'Cat, Semen', 'Dog, Semen', 'Goat, Semen', 'Horse, Semen', 'Pig, Semen', 'Rabbit/Rodent, Semen' and 'Sheep, Semen' (05119985). The catalogue offers no cat or dog embryos or ova and no poultry, fish or bee germinal product. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-001, -p5-031, -p5-069 to -p5-071; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-036 to -p1-038; c-229, c-230, c-germinal-products-002)

Each germinal item offers its own species: Cattle offers Bison bison, Bos taurus and Bubalus bubalis, with Bovidae as well for semen; Horse offers Equus asinus and Equus caballus; Goat Capra hircus; Pig Sus scrofa domesticus; Sheep Ovis aries; Cat Felis catus; Dog Canis familiaris; and Rabbit/Rodent, Semen one row labelled Rabbit/Rodent. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-138, -p2-141 to -p2-143, -p2-145 to -p2-155-m1, -p3-037; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-061, -p3-062, -p3-076)

Ticking Domestic cattle (Bos taurus) under Cattle, Semen shows '1 selected' with a 'Cattle, Semen (05111000):' line and a 'Bos taurus' chip, as the live-animal search does. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-063; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-009)

In the published payload each germinal trade line carries the type code SEMEN for a semen item, EMBRYO for an embryos item and OVA for an ova item, and embryos and ova are always separate trade lines. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-036 to -p1-039; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-029; c-273)
openQuestions: Blocked: whoever owns the commodity integration must make the central commodity list reach the animals frontend, after which the germinal catalogue and search are re-distilled from that list (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm, point 2). Until then the germinal set offers today's germinal lines (req-1927) with the interim type codes (req-1928).
rows.notes: existingRow inc-191, whose id, theme, blocked status, dependencies (inc-016, inc-017) and external dependency (inc-012 in commodities-and-reason) the combiner keeps. Combines the catalogue (req-093), its selection panel (req-1783) and the separate embryo and ova trade lines (req-1800): all three wait on the same catalogue and change once it lands. c-229 and c-230 (ruled): embryos and ova are separate items, cat and dog semen are separate items, and the prototype's combined naming and its cat and dog embryos and ova are set aside. c-germinal-products-002 (ruled): a germinal commodity's code is the eight-digit code the catalogue carries, shown with its leading zero. c-282 (ruled): this is the blocked half of the germinal commodity work, the interim half being inc-016 and inc-017. Re-check at build: half the blocker has gone, because the live commodity search already reads the central list and tells germinal codes apart; what is left is drawing the germinal catalogue from it.

rows.title: Waiting on design: the germinal search lists its results as the trader types, with the number announced
rows.detail: The germinal commodity search is to list matching commodities as the trader types, each with its code and species, and announce the number of results. The behaviour waits twice over: on design's answer about search as you type, and on the germinal catalogue, which is drawn from the central commodity list. When both are settled it is built as design says, or dropped if design drops it.
acceptanceCriteria: If design keeps search as you type: typing 'semen' in the germinal search lists the eight semen commodities in name order (Cat, Semen; Cattle, Semen (05111000); Dog, Semen; Goat, Semen; Horse, Semen; Pig, Semen; Rabbit/Rodent, Semen; Sheep, Semen, all others 05119985), offering 12 species rows, with Cattle, Semen offering 'Bovidae' and Rabbit/Rodent, Semen offering 'Rabbit/Rodent' as group rows. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-098; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-059 to -p3-062; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-059, -p1-060, -p2-009)

If design keeps search as you type: a visually hidden polite live region announces the number of germinal results, such as '12 results available'. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-098; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-060; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-059, -p2-009)

With JavaScript off, the germinal search still lists the same commodities when the trader presses the page's Search button. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-059, -p2-010, -p2-016)
openQuestions: Design must answer whether the commodity search lists results as the trader types, and with which accepted component: built as design says, or dropped if design drops it (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-059; c-012).

Blocked also until the central commodity list reaches the animals frontend and the germinal catalogue is drawn from it, because these results are that catalogue (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-060; c-282).
rows.notes: existingRow inc-014, the waiting-on-design row that already holds this area's req-1782 beside the commodities area's live-animals half of the same behaviour (req-072, req-073, req-074). The combiner keeps inc-014's id, its waiting-on-design theme, its blocked status, its dependency on inc-016 and the criteria already there, and merges these germinal criteria in, as one increment for the search-as-you-type question. Kept apart from the germinal catalogue row (inc-191) because it carries a second blocker, design's answer, which the catalogue does not. The germinal criteria are written as conditionals because the behaviour exists only if design keeps it.

rows.title: Waiting on design: the germinal dates' 'Choose date' calendar
rows.detail: The germinal collection and production dates are built as single text inputs, and the design shows them with a calendar toggle as well. Advice is against a calendar for a date a user reads off a document, so the calendar waits on design's answer: a calendar enhancing the text input, a plain date field, or the three-part date input instead. This row builds whichever design answers, or is dropped if design is content with the text input alone.
acceptanceCriteria: If design keeps the calendar: each germinal date field has a 'Choose date' toggle opening a month grid with previous and next year and month buttons, 'Select' and 'Close', and picking a day fills that date's text input; with JavaScript off the text input works as before. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-076; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-044, -p1-045, -p1-092; c-283)

If design answers that the three-part date input will do instead: each germinal date is asked as Day, Month and Year fields, and the format, real-date and leniency rules of the single-input row still apply to the date they make. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-092; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-064)
openQuestions: Design must answer whether the germinal dates keep the calendar, or a plain date field or the three-part date input will do instead: built as design says, and the row is dropped if the single text input already built is enough (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-092; c-283).
rows.notes: existingRow inc-192, whose id, waiting-on-design theme, blocked status, dependency on inc-053 and external dependency (inc-206 in design-snagging) the combiner keeps. One slice (req-253). c-283 (ruled): the single text input with its hint is built now in inc-053, and this row only enhances or replaces it. If design keeps the calendar, build each germinal date with the shared date field so it takes the house look rather than a style of its own; the package the calendar needs is already a dependency of the frontend.
